blocks.text:
The Celestial Archipelago is a cluster of floating islands suspended within the Astral Expanse, each island a fragment of a greater consciousness. These realms are not bound by time, space, or the laws of the material world. They serve as waystations, temples, markets, and battlegrounds — home to beings of light, shadow, and everything in between.

To reach the Archipelago is to step beyond the veil, where thought becomes form and dreams shape reality.

items.title: The Veiled Spires
items.text: Home to the Archivists and keepers of lost knowledge. A realm of endless libraries and shifting towers.

items.title: The Dreamer's Reach
items.text: A tranquil realm where thought manifests as landscape. Visions, prophecies, and memories coalesce here.

items.title: The Eternal Market
items.text: A hub of trade, culture, and interdimensional exchange. All paths, all peoples, all things.

items.title: The Forgotten Tomb
items.text: A fractured island of ancient ruins and sleeping powers. Not all that is forgotten should be found.

blocks.text: The islands are not places, they are states of being.
